name: auto_alert_recovery
description: Automated alert triage and recovery: ingests an alert, uses AI to analyze and investigate it with vector DB runbook search, assesses risk, then routes HIGH/MEDIUM to human review and LOW to AI auto-execution, followed by action execution and verification.

tasks.name: alert_ingestion
tasks.description: Normalize and enrich the raw alert payload into a structured format

messages.message: You are an alert normalization engine. You receive raw AlertManager payloads and normalize them into a structured format. Parse the input and return a JSON object with exactly these fields: source (string), alertname (string), alert_severity (string: critical|high|medium|low|info), affected_instances (array of strings), status (string: firing|resolved), summary (string, one sentence), description (string, detailed description combining all alert annotations), startsAt (string, ISO timestamp of first alert), k8s_info (object containing: cluster, namespace), promql (string, extract the PromQL expression from the generatorURL of the first alert by URL-decoding the g0.expr query parameter; empty string if not present).

tasks.name: analyze_alert
tasks.description: AI-powered alert analysis to extract intent, affected components, and urgency

messages.message: You are an SRE expert. Analyze the incoming alert and extract: alert type, affected service, potential root cause, and urgency. Respond in JSON with fields: alert_type, affected_service, potential_root_cause, urgency, summary.

tasks.name: doc_search
tasks.description: Search vector DB for relevant runbooks and past incident reports

tasks.name: investigation
tasks.description: Deep root-cause analysis combining alert analysis with retrieved runbooks

messages.message: You are a senior SRE performing incident investigation. Based on the alert analysis and retrieved runbooks, determine the likely root cause and recommended remediation steps. Respond in JSON with fields: root_cause, confidence_score (0-1), recommended_actions (array of strings), estimated_impact, affected_systems (array of strings).

tasks.name: risk_assessment
tasks.description: Assess the risk level of the proposed remediation: HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW

messages.message: You are a risk assessment engine for SRE operations. Given an incident investigation report, determine the risk level of the proposed remediation. Risk levels: HIGH (potential data loss, production outage, or irreversible action), MEDIUM (service degradation possible, rollback is complex), LOW (safe rollback, isolated scope, well-tested procedure). Respond in JSON with fields: risk_level (HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW), risk_reason, auto_executable (boolean), requires_human_approval (boolean).

tasks.name: decision_router
tasks.description: Route to human review (HIGH/MEDIUM risk) or AI auto-execute (LOW risk)
tasks.expression: function evaluate() { var risk = $.risk_level; if (risk === 'HIGH' || risk === 'MEDIUM') { return 'HUMAN_REVIEW'; } return 'AUTO_EXECUTE'; } evaluate();

HUMAN_REVIEW.name: human_review
HUMAN_REVIEW.description: Human operator reviews the investigation findings and approves or modifies the remediation plan

defaultCase.name: ai_auto_execute
defaultCase.description: AI selects the safest remediation action for low-risk automated execution

messages.message: You are an automated remediation system. Select the safest and most appropriate action from the recommended actions list. Output a JSON execution plan with fields: selected_action, action_parameters (object), rollback_plan, approval_status (set to 'AUTO_APPROVED').

tasks.name: join_review
tasks.description: Wait for whichever review branch completed (human or AI auto)

tasks.name: execute_action
tasks.description: Execute the approved remediation action against the target system

tasks.name: verification
tasks.description: Verify whether the remediation resolved the alert

messages.message: You are a verification agent for SRE incident resolution. Given the original alert details and the execution results, determine whether the remediation was successful. Respond in JSON with fields: status (RESOLVED|PARTIAL|FAILED), confidence_score (0-1), summary, next_steps (array of strings, empty if RESOLVED).
